title: Cardiovascular Risk Factors in Overweight Adolescents
brief_summary: The aim of the present study was to determine the effects of either a multidisciplinary approach or intensity-controlled interval training on cardiovascular risk factors in overweight adolescents.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Overweight and obese adolescents in the Trondheim area, referred to medical treatment at St. Olav's Hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any coexisting medical illnesses
